name: Ecoajedrez-AR
status: Galactic 8-node chess quest pilot with real chess.js positions and local progress, independent camera height for Skybox 360, optional external CC0 3D GLB set staging (no third-party models actually included), pre-APK PWA/TWA research. Physical Android 3D/AR and puzzle move playability require user tests.
onlinePvP: Casual PeerJS beta, six-character code and QR with camera scanner (native BarcodeDetector / lazy in-browser jsQR), validation restricts invite origin/path. Real two-device session requires device test; unranked and unaudited anti-cheat.
modelType: Six tiny, original, embedded-buffer glTF Staunton types (one per piece kind), with Royal arcane 3D embellishments and procedural fantasy and classic variants; third-party character/franchise GLBs not included
arImplementation: WebXR hit-test with touch/aim + recovery dialog after interrupted Android session; screen-drag feedback, NOT camera hand recognition or hand occlusion
validationBasis: El usuario confirmó AR y funcionamiento invitado de v0.5; el nuevo 0.6 necesita pruebas físicas, entre dos celulares y desbloqueo.
googleAuth: Server-only BFF code exists but no Cloudflare Functions secrets deployed; Google unavailable on GitHub Pages; guest fully usable
localPersistence: LocalStorage por UID o invitado, sin servicio externo
diagnostics: WebXR, WebGL2, Firebase SDK, PeerJS, modelos, conexión, micrófono
securityReview: No external domains, keys, paid services, new login, third-party fonts, pixels or tracking; no changes to server and gameplay
ui: v0.14.3: per-board paired 3D kingdoms with dual preview; classic may choose biome, themed boards lock matching biome; victory uses vista_de_ajedrez_celestial_encantado.webp

media.notes: Muted intro auto-start per browser tab/session (after page ready, if reduced-motion/data-saver/browser restrictions permit); stop at 10s video playback or 20s network stall cap; keep post-intro static backdrop. Asset downloads continue asynchronously. No auth/API secrets exposed.

visualFidelity: Functional reinterpretation of user's approved fantasy look, not photo-identical; uses existing user-owned video and poster; no unlicensed materials

modelCache.licensing: Original procedurally created models; legacy fictional-character models not included

environments.AR: decorations hidden; WebXR camera passthrough remains clean; extended AR immersion postponed
environments.pairedMode: each playable board has its own 3D kingdom background once owner uploads matching WebP; WebXR stays camera transparent
environments.manifest: app/imagenes/entornos/manifest.json, created only in static Pages build

boardTextures.imageMapping: 13 calibrated per-image grid rectangles projected to exactly 8x8 world units; frame dimensions and offset match; 7x7 WebP reconstructed as 8x8

skybox360.phase: Carpetas y probador independiente; batallas finales pendientes
skybox360.viewer: skybox-test.html con entrada explícita, salida y comprobación directa de caras
skybox360.motion: 3DoF: giro por arrastre o deviceorientation autorizado
skybox360.availabilityFallback: If Pages generated manifest is missing or stale, probe six exact cubemap WebP URLs via HEAD; do not incorrectly claim files missing.
skybox360.cameraView: Fixed virtual viewer position; free 360 rotational 3DoF view; real board stays at world origin
skybox360.ui: Hide or show HUD; persistent mini controls to refocus board or exit
skybox360.AR: Existing real-surface WebXR hit-test only. Full virtual kingdom not available in AR, no physical area mapping.
skybox360.entry: Configure the selected board and opponent, choose Reino 360, Start; lab is debug-only.
skybox360.playableBoardMap: skybox-config.js pairs each of 13 realm IDs with its board texture

playExperiences.normal: same game with paired panoramic backdrop
playExperiences.skybox: same game, CubeTexture, 6 faces required, 3DoF gyroscope optional
playExperiences.ar: real camera + surface hit-test + anchored chessboard and nonopaque decorative arch; no arch on unanchored hologram

experienceModeCards.ui: Three cards desktop, compact rows on mobile; square originals, no stretching

arRoom.geometry: six textured faces mapped onto a transparent interior cubic environment
arRoom.position: placed board hit-test position; WebXR anchor when available, otherwise session-local
arRoom.notes: Virtual cubic enclosure is visual only; no obstacle/physical-boundary detection. Headset WebXR support depends on the platform; no physical 6DoF proof.
